description: This Java source file defines a generic Akka actor class called MessageAggregator, which manages message collection and forwarding with a timeout mechanism. It forwards the first received message, waits for a specified number of messages of a certain type, and then reports the collected messages back to the sender before stopping.

classes.name: MessageAggregator
classes.description: A generic Akka actor that aggregates messages of a specific type, forwarding the first message, collecting a set number of messages, and then sending this collection back to the original sender after a timeout or upon receiving all expected messages.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating a MessageAggregator actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the initial message handling behavior, forwarding the first message and transitioning to listening behavior.

methods.name: listeningBehavior
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles messages after the first message has been forwarded, collecting messages and handling timeout.

methods.name: handleTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout event, logs the current state, and triggers reporting and stopping.

methods.name: reportAndStop
methods.description: Reports collected messages to the original sender and stops the actor.
